description: This file defines the IGatewayListProvider interface in the Orleans.Messaging namespace, which provides methods and properties for managing and retrieving a list of gateway endpoints in Orleans clusters.

classes.name: IGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Interface that defines methods and properties for providing Orleans gateway (silo) information, including initialization, fetching the list of gateways, and configuration settings.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, invoked before other methods.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of gateway URIs that clients can use to connect to the Orleans cluster.
